title: Concierge demo journey screens + README flow for template apps
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Produce a compact, developer-facing 'concierge' onboarding demo for the template apps repo that includes a) a canonical set of reference screenshots for desktop/tablet/mobile, b) a concise README walkthrough diagram (1 page) and c) 2 short GIF micro-flows demonstrating first-run and rollback behavior. This ticket covers visual assets, README diagram, and handoff files to engineering docs and the template-apps repo.

Scope:
- 3 device layouts (desktop 1440px, tablet 768px, mobile 375px) exported in light & dark themes.
- README single-page flow diagram (SVG + PNG) showing: Sign up -> Create project -> Select template -> First run (playground) -> Persisted secrets & routing -> Canary toggle.
- Two micro GIFs (max 6s, loop): onboarding wizard completing, and canary rollback triggered.
- Localization: placeholders for en-US and fr-FR copy (screens and README).
- Design tokens and Figma file link for engineers: spacing, color tokens, and overlay patterns.

Deliverables:
- assets/screens/{desktop,tablet,mobile}/[light,dark]/*.png and high-res originals.
- README-diagram.svg and README-diagram.png placed in docs/imgs/.
- gifs/onboarding_flow.gif, gifs/canary_rollback.gif.
- Figma export guide + token table (tokens/README.md).

Non-goal: full-motion prototype or copywriting for every locale (we provide placeholders and guidance).

design_notes: Visual direction: clean developer-first look — monospace code overlays, subtle device drop-shadows, and a concierge badge in the upper-right of first-run screenshot. Use component snapshots rather than full-page app screenshots where possible to surface relevant affordances (canary toggle, request logs, rollout slider). Provide alt text templates for each asset. Use 1400px wide for desktop exports and 2x retina for the high-res folder.
qa_checklist: Verify image filenames follow naming convention: concierge_<device>_<theme>_<state>.png
Check README diagram links and anchors render correctly on GitHub (svg + png fallback)
Confirm GIF loop and max file size
Validate localized copy placeholders for fr-FR appear in separate asset sets
Confirm PR includes tokens/docs and the design handoff checklist
